title: Sort each subject into the right level of government
instructions: For each subject, decide which level of the Indian government is mainly responsible: UNION (national subjects), STATE (within a state) or LOCAL (village or city level).

bins.name: Union
bins.description: National subjects — affect the whole country (defence, foreign affairs, currency, railways, post).

bins.name: State
bins.description: Within-the-state subjects (police, agriculture, public health, much of education).

bins.name: Local
bins.description: Village or city-level subjects (wells, street lights, sanitation, school maintenance).

items.name: State police force
items.explanation: Police are mainly a State subject.

items.name: Public hospitals run by the state
Most school education in the state
Maintenance of a primary school building
